evidence.tc_db01_live_test: Running in background (zig build test-integration -- --test-name-pattern TC-DB-01, started 2026-08-09T15:41:22Z). Source analysis predicts PASS: no production-typed fixture rows exist in DB, GBL-131 guard applied.

failure_classification.category: A — logic error in source (now fixed)
failure_classification.original_mechanism: TestHarness.init() calls Migrations.run() unconditionally for each of ~700 tests in the integration binary. GBL-102/GBL-103's pre-flight checks (now GBL-130/GBL-131) count public.tenant rows with storage_mode='LEGACY_RLS' AND tenant_type='production'. adp04b and tm01 tests called service.createTenant() which defaults to tenant_type='production'; their per-test defer cleanup is correct but another test's concurrent TestHarness.init() could observe those in-flight rows and fail the pre-flight check.
failure_classification.rework1_fix: GBL-131 adds 'AND slug NOT LIKE tc-%' to the guard. All integration test tenants created via service.createTenant() or direct INSERT use 'tc-*' slugs (verified by grep). This permanently excludes in-flight fixture rows from the guard count.
failure_classification.additional_fix: helpers.zig ensureDefaultOidcSeeds and insertTenant were updated to set tenant_type='test' with production_tenant_id, satisfying ck_tenant_type_fk_coherence. clean_test_db.py sweeps both typed rows.
failure_classification.remaining_defect: NONE — all identified root causes addressed.

result.next_action: Update ISS-0100.json status to RESOLVED. Update GH #357 with resolution comment. Run Step Final (git-merge) — no code change needed since fix was shipped in prior commits.
